title: L1448 IRS3B: Dust Polarization Aligned with Spiral Features, Tracing Gas Flows
question: Which dust polarization mechanisms (magnetic alignment, self-scattering, mechanical alignment) operate in the envelope, circum-multiple disk, spirals and compact sources of the protostellar multiple L1448 IRS3B

recipe.goal: Self-calibrate and image Stokes I, Q, U
recipe.method: Phase-only then amplitude+phase self-calibration with auto_selfcal on NRAO-calibrated data, then tclean Stokes I, Q, U maps with Briggs robust 0.5
key_parameters: Band 4 phase-only intervals inf-EB, inf, 26.21s, 8.06s, 4.03s, int; amp+phase 300s
Band 7 phase-only inf-EB, inf, 48.38s; amp+phase inf

recipe.goal: Derive debiased polarized intensity, angle and noise
recipe.method: P_m = sqrt(Q^2+U^2); sigma_P from sigma_Q and sigma_U; debias with Rice-type PDF at S/N<3 and with P = sqrt(Q^2+U^2-sigma_P^2) at higher S/N; chi = 0.5 arctan(U/Q)
key_parameters: Low S/N threshold 3 sigma_P for PDF debiasing

recipe.goal: Make brightness temperature maps and constrain spectral index/optical depth
recipe.method: Brightness temperature maps without Rayleigh-Jeans approximation; spectral index lower limits tested with mtmfs and a restricted uv range of 50-1000 klambda with uv taper to match beam areas
key_parameters: uv range 50-1000 klambda with taper (beam areas within a few percent)
assumptions: Brightness temperature is the temperature required for a blackbody to match the observed intensity

recipe.goal: Identify polarization regions by morphology and fraction
recipe.method: Regions classed as magnetic, scattering or mechanical using polarization fraction, location and angle relative to disk minor axis and spirals

recipe.goal: Model polarization angles from the continuum spiral spine and compare with observations
recipe.method: Mask spirals in Stokes I, fit cubic splines (UnivariateSpline, smoothing factor 5, 4 segments in Band 7), take spline slope per pixel as the model vector, compare with observed angles
assumptions: Spiral arms create a drift velocity of dust relative to gas, traced by the continuum

recipe.goal: Measure mean fractional polarization along spirals and in inner regions
recipe.method: Mean P/I per beam along the spiral feature and in the high-resolution inner region, per band
